html:
The Wunumara are an Aboriginal people of northwest Queensland, in country along the Flinders River around present day Richmond and Kynuna.

They spoke Wanamarra, a language of the Mayi group, related to that of the Ngawun, their neighbours. Other neighbours on the map include the Mayi-Kulan and the Kalkadoon to the west. Pastoral runs spread across the Flinders plains in the 1860s. The language is now extinct. See Aboriginal Australian societies.
sum: The Wunumara are an Aboriginal people of northwest Queensland, in country along the Flinders River around present day Richmond and Kynuna.
